# outer_op { #jaxidem.utils.outer_op }

```python
utils.outer_op(a, b, op=lambda x, y: x * y)
```

Computes the outer operation of two vectors, a generalisation of the outer
product. Wowza

## Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name   | Type      | Description                                                                                                | Default              |
|--------|-----------|------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|----------------------|
| a      | ArrayLike | Array of the first vector.  Assumed shape (n,)                                                             | _required_           |
| b      | ArrayLike | Array of the second vector. Assumed shape (m,)                                                             | _required_           |
| op     | Callable  | A jit-function acting on an element of vec1 and an element of vec2. By default, this is the outer product. | `lambda x, y: x * y` |

## Returns {.doc-section .doc-section-returns}

| Name   | Type      | Description                                                                                                         |
|--------|-----------|---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
| result | ArrayLike | The matrix of the result of applying operation to every pair of elements from the two vectors. Return shape (n, m). |
